darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
✗ Cannot read /Users/runner/.claude

  Claude Code stores its config in ~/.claude/ but this directory
  either doesn't exist or isn't readable by your current user.

  To fix:
    1. Make sure Claude Code has been run at least once
    2. Check permissions: ls -la ~/.claude/
    3. If needed:  chmod u+r ~/.claude
